title: 2×CTAB Protocol for DNA Isolation from Aiptasia and Symbiodinium
author: Pringle Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qx6dxre

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Homogenize each anemone in 500 µl 2× CTAB buffer using a rotor‑stator in a screw‑cap or safe‑lock 1.5–2 ml microcentrifuge tube; ensure tubes are chemical‑resistant and clean the rotor afterwards.

steps.title: Shear homogenate with needle
steps.instruction: Pass the homogenate through a 25‑gauge needle five times to shear cells.

steps.title: Add glass beads and vortex
steps.instruction: Add approximately 200 µl of 0.5 mm glass beads, then vortex at ≥2000 rpm for 1–5 min until no cell clumps are visible.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 3.6 µl Proteinase K (20 mg ml⁻¹), mix by inverting several times, then incubate at 65 °C for 30–60 min (invert occasionally; ~20 min may suffice for less dense samples).

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, TE‑buffered to pH ≥ 7), vortex a few seconds to form a milky emulsion, centrifuge 10 min at 14 000 ×g, and transfer ~550 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Chloroform wash of aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) (or plain chloroform), vortex briefly, centrifuge 10 min at 14 000 ×g, then transfer ~450 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml 100 % ethanol (molecular‑biology grade) to the aqueous phase and mix well; incubate ≥30 min at room temperature; centrifuge ≥30 min at 14 000 ×g at RT (orient tubes uniformly); carefully decant the supernatant (pellet may be invisible).

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl 70 % ethanol without mixing, centrifuge 5 min at 14 000 ×g, then remove supernatant with a pipette (use a 1000 µl pipette with a 200 µl tip) being careful not to disturb the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet for 10 min or until no ethanol is visible, then add 30 µl ddH₂O or 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.5 (TE buffer may be used but EDTA could affect downstream enzymes). Store at –20 °C or use immediately.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 8 µl RNase A (10 mg ml⁻¹ stock) to the DNA solution, mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min (extend to 1 h for large samples).

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, TE‑buffered to pH ≥ 7), vortex briefly, centrifuge 10 min at 14 000 ×g, and transfer ~500 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.
